toolsPreview.name: get_sdn_list_meta
toolsPreview.description: Return the provenance of the loaded OFAC SDN list: source URL, publish date, record count, fetch time, and the source + index content hashes. No input, no PII. Use this to confirm which list version a screening ran against.

toolsPreview.name: screen_sdn
toolsPreview.description: Screen a name against the public OFAC SDN list. Returns a verdict (no-match / potential-match) and ranked matches with the OFAC list entry and the field that matched. The query is NOT stored or anchored on this path. A potential match requires human review — it is information, not a legal or compliance determination.
